claim_text:
Tomingley continues to explore renewable energy
solutions to provide an effective proportion of the
power requirements for the Tomingley processing
plant and other site infrastructure.
metric_name:
Renewable energy solution activity; 
diesel/electric hybrid underground mining equipment
context_text: During FY2025, a fleet of new diesel/electric hybrid underground mining equipment arrived on-site
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: claim具体指向探索可为Tomingley处理厂和现场基础设施供电的renewable energy solutions，但提供的证据仅是柴油/电动混合地下采矿设备到场，并不直接证明正在探索或实施可再生能源供电方案。因此证据与claim核心不匹配，不能作为有效支持。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that Tomingley is actively continuing to explore renewable energy solutions to supply an effective proportion of power for the processing plant and other site infrastructure. The provided evidence fields only state the metric name “Renewable energy solution activity; diesel/electric hybrid underground mining equipment” and an extracted value of “a fleet,” which indicates (at most) the presence of some diesel/electric hybrid underground mining equipment. There is no substantive evidence of ongoing exploration activities, no description of renewable energy solutions, no indication that these solutions relate to powering the processing plant or site infrastructure, and no quantified or otherwise specified “effective proportion” of power requirements being met. As written, the claim’s core meaning is not verified by the provided evidence.
